title: Conformance torture test
description: Exercises number formatting, strings, rules semantics, layers, inline geometry, gradients, clips, camera zoom, culling and the full glyph set. Not a game.

do: state.sum = 0.1 + 0.2; state.mod = -7 % 3; state.inf = 1 / 0; state.cat = 'a' + 1 + 2.5 + true + null
state.acc = state.acc + sqrt(state.n) * 0.37 - floor(state.n / 7) + round(2.5) + round(-2.5) + abs(-1.25)
if (k == 0) { spawn('dot', {x: rand(0, W), y: rand(0, H), vx: rand(-60, 60), vy: rand(-60, 60), tags: ['dot', 'wrap'], data: {ttl: rand(0.5, 2)}}) }
if (held('go') && pressed('go')) state.s += 'P' else if (held('go')) state.s += 'h'
state.mx = max(1, 2, state.n) + min(4, clamp(state.n, 2, 5)) + lerp(0, 10, 0.25) + sign(-3)

rules.do: self.scale = 1 + 0.25 * ((state.n % 40) / 40); if (self.x > W) self.x -= W; if (self.y < 0) self.y += H
self.d = 'M0 ' + str(-6 - (frame % 3)) + ' L5 3 L-5 3 Z'; self.rot += PI / 7
